name: WuXi Biologics (Cayman) Inc.
summary: WuXi Biologics (Cayman) Inc., an investment holding company, provides end-to-end solutions and services for biologics discovery, development, and manufacturing for biologics industry in the People's Republic of China, North America, Europe, Singapore, Japan, South Korea, Australia, and Brazil. It operates through two segments: Biologics and XDC.
